meaning: Private company records reach the wrong people.
clues: It affects a company, not one person or a safety step.
The records end up where people who should not see them can get at them.
A company may tell affected people what happened and what steps to take next.
Its name has two words and starts with D.
assumes: Identity theft is when someone uses your details to act as you
A data backup is a copy of records made on purpose
A credit freeze is a step you take to block new accounts

decoys.meaning: When someone uses your details to pretend to be you.
A copy of records made on purpose so they can be restored later.
A step you take to block new accounts from being opened in your name.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. If a company says your information was exposed, change that password and turn on two-factor login. Use the FTC's breach advice to see what to do next.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A broken filing cabinet could expose paper records. A computer can have the same problem.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Be careful of follow-up messages that ask for more private details. Contact the company through a number you already trust.

sources.name: FTC, Have you been affected by a data breach?

blank.sentence: A store told its customers that their private records had reached the wrong people. That was a ___.

why: If a company warns you, change that password and add two-factor login.

situations.text: A company says your information was exposed. You change that password and turn on two-factor login.
situations.why: Changing that password and adding two-factor login protects the account.
